problem.notConnected.message: No AI model is connected to this workspace. Connect one in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant: it's free, with your own key.
problem.notConnected.note: an AI feature was used before a model was connected; the reader can connect one

problem.notConnectedAsk.message: No AI model is connected to this workspace. {helpers} can connect one in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.
problem.notConnectedAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.notConnectedAlone: No AI model is connected to this workspace. Someone with integrations:manage can connect one in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.

problem.featureOff.message: {feature, select, subject_ideas {Subject ideas with AI are} rewrite {Rewriting with AI is} translate {Translation with AI is} alt_text {Alt text with AI is} accessibility_fix {Accessibility fixes with AI are} segment_draft {Segment drafts with AI are} report_summary {Report summaries with AI are} other {This AI feature is}} turned off for this workspace. {helpers} can turn it on in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.
problem.featureOff.note: a feature switched off in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant; helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.featureOffAlone: {feature, select, subject_ideas {Subject ideas with AI are} rewrite {Rewriting with AI is} translate {Translation with AI is} alt_text {Alt text with AI is} accessibility_fix {Accessibility fixes with AI are} segment_draft {Segment drafts with AI are} report_summary {Report summaries with AI are} other {This AI feature is}} turned off for this workspace. Someone with integrations:manage can turn it on in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.

problem.capReached.message: This month's AI budget ({cap}) is used up. AI features return on {date}, or {helpers} can raise the cap.
problem.capReached.note: cap: $25.00; date: 1 Nov; helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.capReachedAlone: This month's AI budget ({cap}) is used up. AI features return on {date}, or someone with integrations:manage can raise the cap.

problem.tokenCapReached.message: This month's AI token cap ({cap} tokens) is used up. AI features return on {date}, or {helpers} can raise the cap.

problem.keyRejected.message: The workspace's model key was rejected by {provider}. Nothing was sent. {helpers} can replace it.
problem.keyRejected.note: provider: Anthropic, OpenAI…; helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.keyRejectedAlone: The workspace's model key was rejected by {provider}. Nothing was sent. Someone with integrations:manage can replace it in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.

problem.providerErrorTwice.message: {provider} returned an error ({status}, {code}) twice. Nothing was changed.

problem.providerError.message: {provider} returned an error ({status}, {code}). Nothing was changed.
problem.providerError.note: status: 500; code: the provider's error type

problem.rateLimited.message: {provider} is limiting requests from this workspace. Try again in {seconds} s; nothing was changed.

problem.rateLimitedNow: {provider} is limiting requests from this workspace. Try again in a minute; nothing was changed.

problem.timeout.message: {provider} didn't answer within {seconds} seconds. Nothing was changed.

problem.unreachable.message: {provider} couldn't be reached ({detail}). Nothing was changed.
problem.unreachable.note: detail: the network error, such as 'connection refused'

problem.blocked.message: {host} is a private address, and this instance doesn't allow private addresses. An instance admin can allow them.

problem.badRequest.message: {provider} refused the request: {detail}. Nothing was changed.
problem.badRequest.note: detail: the provider's message, such as 'model not found'

problem.unreadable: {provider}'s answer couldn't be read. Nothing was changed.

problem.noImageInput.message: Alt text needs a model that reads images. {helpers} can connect one that does.
problem.noImageInput.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.noImageInputAlone: Alt text needs a model that reads images. Someone with integrations:manage can connect one that does.
problem.demoModel: The demo's sample model only answers in development. Connect your own model in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.

problem.demoLanguage.message: The demo's sample model translates into Spanish and German only. To translate into {language}, connect your own model in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.
problem.demoLanguage.note: the demo connection was asked for a language its recordings lack; language: Vietnamese

problem.privateAddress.message: {host} resolves to {ip}, a private address. An instance admin can allow private addresses.

problem.privateHost.message: {host} is a private address. An instance admin can allow private addresses.

problem.badAddress.message: Use the server's full address, like {example}.

problem.keyNeeded.message: Paste the API key from your {provider} account.
problem.keyNeeded.note: provider: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI

problem.azureNeeds: Paste your Azure OpenAI endpoint (like https://acme.openai.azure.com) and the deployment's name.
problem.modelNeeded: Pick a model, or type its name.

problem.oneModel.message: One model per workspace: disconnect {provider} first to switch provider.

problem.notConnectedYet: No AI model is connected yet. Connect one first.

problem.capRange.message: Set a monthly cap between {min} and {max}, or choose no cap.
problem.capRange.note: min, max: amounts in dollars, $1.00 and $100,000.00

problem.tokenCapRange.message: Set a token cap of at least {min} tokens a month, or choose no cap.

problem.priceRange.message: Prices are dollars per million tokens, between {min} and {max}.

problem.unknownFeature: That isn't one of the assistant's features.

problem.tooLong.message: That's more text than the assistant takes at once ({count} characters, up to {max}). Select a part of it.

problem.instructionNeeded: Write what to change, for example "Make it shorter and friendlier".

problem.imageUnreadable.note: detail: why, such as: it is over 5 MB

problem.imageMissing: Pick an image first: this one has no address.

image.address.note: why an image can't be read, after “The image couldn't be read:”

image.notInLibrary: it isn't in this workspace's media library
image.where: only images on the web or in the media library can be described

image.status.note: status: an HTTP status, such as 404

image.format: it isn't a PNG, JPEG or GIF image
problem.suggestionGone: That suggestion isn't yours, or it's older than a day. Ask for a new one.
problem.noSourceText: The source version has no text to translate yet.
problem.sameLanguage: Pick a language other than the one the email is written in.

problem.notWorkspaceLanguage.message: {language} isn't one of this workspace's languages. Add it in Settings › General › Languages first.

problem.sourceChanged: The email changed since this translation was made. Translate it again.
problem.nothingAccepted: Accept at least one block, or reject the translation.
problem.descriptionNeeded: Describe who should be in the segment, for example "clicked in the last 30 days but didn't open".
problem.notSent: This campaign hasn't sent anything yet, so there are no results to summarize.

problem.campaignId.note: a request without the campaign it is about

problem.suggestionId.note: a request without the suggestion it keeps or accepts

activity.newSegment.note: the AI activity log's “On” column, for a segment not saved yet

activity.onField.note: the AI activity log's “On” column for a rewrite of a campaign's subject or preheader; name: the campaign's name

activity.rateLimited.note: why a request failed, after “Error ·” in the AI activity log

activity.keyRejected.note: status: the provider's HTTP status, such as 401

version.translated.note: a language version's name in its history; model: the model's name

segment.dropped.note: a segment draft used conditions the builder doesn't have

test.prompt.note: the fixed prompt of Test connection; keep it a plain instruction

notify.tokenUsageBody.message: {spent} of this month's {cap} tokens. At the cap, AI features pause until {date}.

notify.tokenCapBody: This month's {cap} tokens are used up. AI features pause until {date}; editing, sending and reports work as usual.
notify.keyTitle: AI key rejected by the provider
